package nats

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"log"

	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// AutoReviewSubscriber consumes the internal taskAnswer.autoChecked command.
type AutoReviewSubscriber struct {
	Conn    *natsgo.Conn
	Subject string
	Queue   string
	Handler func(ctx context.Context, payload []byte) error
}

// Subscribe registers queue subscription.
func (s AutoReviewSubscriber) Subscribe(ctx context.Context) error {
	if s.Conn == nil {
		return nil
	}
	_, err := s.Conn.QueueSubscribe(s.Subject, s.Queue, func(msg *natsgo.Msg) {
		if err := s.Handler(ctx, msg.Data); err != nil {
			log.Printf("auto review handler error: %v", err)
		}
	})
	return err
}

// DecodeAutoReview converts payload into map for testing convenience.
func DecodeAutoReview(data []byte, dest any) error {
	return json.Unmarshal(data, dest)
}
